title: All My Love, Jesus: Personal Reminders From the Heart of God
author: Sheri Rose Shepherd
target_audience: Women and men looking to deepen their relationship with God
Readers experiencing spiritual struggles or seeking encouragement
Anyone interested in Christian devotionals or faith-based self-care
core_themes: Daily encouragement from a biblical perspective
Affirmations of worth and belonging in Christ
primary_purpose: To provide readers with daily reminders of God’s love, encouragement, and personal presence, offering comfort, hope, and a sense of connection with Jesus through short, heartfelt devotionals.

structure_format.narrative_style: Personal, warm, and direct—written as if Jesus is directly addressing the reader
structure_format.organization: Arranged as daily entries or devotionals, each focused on a particular promise, truth, or aspect of God’s love
features: Space for personal reflection or journaling

key_concepts_lessons: Jesus’ love is unconditional, unchanging, and always accessible.
Readers are never alone—God is present in every circumstance.
Spiritual identity and self-worth are rooted in God’s promises, not worldly standards.
Faith can be a source of healing, comfort, and direction through life’s challenges.
Personal prayer and reflective time with God are vital for spiritual growth.
notable_features: Written in a deeply personal, first-person voice as 'letters from Jesus'
Designed for daily use as a devotional or inspirational tool
Focus on affirming God’s love and promises
Incorporates scriptural references to anchor devotional messages
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2021, the book reflects a broader modern movement toward highly personal, experiential Christian devotionals, responding to a need for encouragement and hope during challenging times like the COVID-19 pandemic.
reception_impact: Well-received in Christian women’s circles and among devotional readers
Praised for its comforting, personal style and scriptural faithfulness
Used in small groups, personal study, and church settings
Appreciated for easy, accessible format—though some may prefer more theological depth
comparable_titles: Come Away My Beloved by Frances J. Roberts
He Whispers Your Name by Cherie Hill
God's Promises for Your Every Need by Jack Countryman
